name: India
standard: GIGW 3.0 (Guidelines for Indian Government Websites and Apps, 2023) — WCAG 2.1 AA

laws.cite: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, s. 46
laws.summary: Service providers, public or private, must provide services per accessibility rules (not opened).

applies_to: Central and state government websites and apps.
requires: Conform to WCAG 2.1 AA via GIGW 3.0
mobile: explicit — GIGW 3.0 covers 'websites and apps' and adds mobile app guidance.
enforcement: STQC certification and a compliant-sites list; RPwD Act remedies. No web-specific penalties verified.
notes: The page opened did not state the WCAG level or whether GIGW is mandatory; WCAG 2.1 AA and the 2023 release come from search summaries. The RPwD s.46 link is Wikipedia, not a primary source. Release year 2023; exact date not verified, so no deadline is listed.
